# vendor/

Unmodified Anthropic blueprint example code, Apache-2.0. See the repo-root `NOTICE`.

- `demo_common/` — FastAPI host, sessions, merchant router
- `web-shared/` — React assistant rail / chat / catalog helpers
- `skills/` — shopping and merchant skill markdown
- `pyproject.toml` — install shim (`pip install -e ./vendor`)

Do not edit these packages. Shopware-specific code lives in `storefront/` and `merchant/`.
